display.purpose: The site name on the homepage hero only.

lede.purpose: The single intro paragraph under a hero or section headline.

label.purpose: Field labels, readout row labels, secondary wordmark line, locale switch.

mono.purpose: Every time, angle, ratio, and coordinate; tabular numerals so nothing reflows while dragging the scrubber.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Ambient lift for chalk panels at rest and tool cards on hover.

shadows.name: sink
shadows.purpose: Subtle inset for a recessed/pressed surface.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Reveal-on-scroll for sections and list items; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: skeleton-sweep
motion.purpose: Loading placeholder sweep, traces the shape of pending content.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-intent action per view, used on dark/hero grounds.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #FFFDF7; color: #14110E; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FFB627; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14110E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline pill for a lower-intent action like locating the device.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #14110E; border: 1px solid rgba(20,17,14,0.4); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #14110E; color: #FFFDF7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14110E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A coordinate or search field: bordered, set into the paper ground, tabular mono for numeric entry.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #FBF4E4; color: #14110E; border: 1px solid rgba(20,17,14,0.25); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 8px; font-family: 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14110E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tool Card
components.description: A link card into one of the site's five modes; flat at rest, lifts and darkens its border on hover.
components.html: Bayangan →Tongkat dan bayangannya, sepanjang hari.
components.css: .ds-card-tool { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; background: #FFFDF7; color: #14110E; border: 1px solid rgba(20,17,14,0.1); border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.3s, border-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-card-tool:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: rgba(20,17,14,0.3); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,17,14,0.06), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(20,17,14,0.28); } .ds-card-tool__row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; } .ds-card-tool:hover .ds-card-tool__row { color: #A3271E; } .ds-card-tool__body { margin-top: 8px; line-height: 1.625; color: rgba(20,17,14,0.8); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: A raised surface for grouped controls or readouts, sitting above the paper ground with an ambient lift.
components.css: .ds-panel { border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(20,17,14,0.1); background: #FFFDF7; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,17,14,0.06), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(20,17,14,0.28); } .ds-panel__label { font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: rgba(20,17,14,0.7); margin-bottom: 12px; }

components.name: Readout Row
components.description: One line of the printed data column: a Label-scale field name against a tabular mono value, separated by a hairline top rule.
components.css: .ds-readout-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 6px 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(20,17,14,0.1); } .ds-readout-row__label { font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: rgba(20,17,14,0.7); } .ds-readout-row__value { font-family: 'Chivo Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #14110E; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: The site header: a two-line wordmark (serif primary name, tracked-caps secondary name) beside a flat text-link list.
components.html:
Hari Tanpa BayanganZero Shadow Day
Bayangan Tanggal
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 32px; padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(20,17,14,0.15); flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-nav__mark { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; color: #14110E; } .ds-nav__mark-primary { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; } .ds-nav__mark-secondary { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: rgba(20,17,14,0.7); } .ds-nav__link { border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; padding-bottom: 2px; color: #14110E; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-nav__link:hover { border-color: #14110E; }

narrative.overview:
The material world is hard tropical light on sun-bleached concrete: warm paper-toned ground, one crisp dark shadow, no softness anywhere except the sky itself. The page reads like a printed instrument notice — a serif masthead, a monospace column of continuously-updating figures, and a single subject (the shadow) that stays darker than everything else on the page because it is the data, not decoration beside it.

Owner direction superseded the original flat, fully bleached-concrete-only palette to let the sky be a real sky — a hero that plays a whole day from deep blue through sunrise orange to true night, rendered by a hand-rolled 8 KB 3D scene rather than a flat wash. What survived that change, because they carry meaning rather than taste, are the two rules every other decision defers to: the shadow is the darkest thing on the page, and vermilion marks the zero shadow day and nothing else.

Almost everything at rest is flat — no drop shadows, no gradients on cards, no gloss. The one ambient shadow (lift) exists purely to lift a chalk-white panel a few pixels off the paper ground, and it appears at rest on panels and on hover for interactive cards, never as decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, sun-bleached paper ground with one uncompromisingly dark ink color — never a mid-gray
A real rendered sky (day-to-night gradient, 3D gnomon scene) sitting inside an otherwise flat, printed-page layout
Every time, angle, and ratio renders in tabular monospace so it never reflows while being dragged
Vermilion (marker) appears in exactly one role: the zero shadow day. Nowhere else.
Sun ochre marks the sun's own path and nothing structural; its low-contrast base hex never carries text or data lines — sun-ink/marker-ink do that instead

rules.name: The Darkest Ink Rule
rules.body: Shadow Ink is the darkest color anywhere in the system. No future token, tint, or opacity value may be introduced that reads darker than #14110E — the shadow's visual primacy is the whole point of the product.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Marker Vermilion marks the zero shadow day and nothing else — not a generic "primary CTA" color, not an error state, not a hover accent. If a new UI moment needs emphasis, reach for Shadow Ink at full opacity or Sun Ochre before reaching for vermilion.

rules.name: The Tabular Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Any angle, time, or shadow ratio renders with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (the .tabular utility). These values update continuously as the date scrubber moves; a non-tabular font would make the layout visibly shift on every frame.

rules.name: The Serif-Is-Rare Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif appears only at h1/h2/h3 scale and the wordmark. It never sets body copy, labels, or UI chrome — its rarity is what keeps the "observatory notice" register from tipping into generic editorial.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Elevation is reserved for panels that are genuinely raised above the paper ground (chalk surfaces) or for a hover response on an interactive card. It is never applied to decorate a static block of text or a section wrapper.

dos: Do keep Shadow Ink (#14110E) the darkest value in any composition — no gray, no near-black, ever reads darker than the shadow itself.

Do use sun-ink / marker-ink instead of the base sun / marker hex whenever the color needs to carry text or a thin data line — the base hues are display-only fills that fail small-text contrast by design.
Do render every time/angle/ratio value in font-mono tabular so dragged values never reflow.
Do keep interactive surfaces flat at rest and reserve the lift shadow for genuine elevation change (panels above ground, cards on hover).
Do use full pill (rounded-full) shape for every button; it's the one consistent silhouette across the whole system.
donts: Don't use Marker Vermilion for anything other than the zero shadow day itself — not a generic CTA, not a form error, not a "new" badge.
Don't set body text, labels, or UI chrome in Instrument Serif; it is reserved for display headings and the wordmark only.
Don't add a drop shadow to a static card or text block at rest — elevation communicates a state change (raised panel, hover), not decoration.
Don't introduce a gray or neutral tone darker than #14110E; every "darker" need should route through Shadow Ink at higher opacity instead of a new near-black token.
Don't scale or restyle the shadow/gnomon rendering for visual effect in a way that breaks the length-to-altitude ratio — it is the literal data, not an illustration (CLAUDE.md invariant 10).
